title: Shelf Rotation Picklist
user: A board gamer with a growing shelf who wants a fair, practical next-play shortlist based on neglect, player count, setup burden, and what is actually available tonight.
smallest_useful_product: Local CSV/manual import of title, last-played, player range, minutes, setup friction, and tags; filters tonight's constraints and creates a 3-5 game rotation with a visible reason for each pick.
success_measure: Among 25 collectors, 60% who import at least 20 games save a generated shortlist twice within 30 days.
constraints: Do not scrape BoardGameGeek or use its branding/data without permission; imports must be user-provided; make the scoring rule inspectable rather than LLM-generated.
